name: speed-up-voiced
about: At the cap, the pace adds up to a hop every ten hops, and each splice skips the shift whose hop best matches the playhead's.

name: slow-down-voiced
about: The same ahead of the clock repeats a stretch of the history instead.

name: bridge
about: Audio about to run out slows down at once, then only as fast as the cap refills its allowance.

name: turns-around
about: A change of direction starts the pace from nothing, and holding forgets it too.

name: narrow-range
about: A decision's range bounds the splice whatever matches better past it.

name: music
about: A chord splices like speech: there is no other kind of content.

name: noise
about: Noise splices wherever it matches best.

name: silence
about: Silence matches every shift equally, so the splice takes the nearest one the range allows.

name: stereo-linked
about: Both channels splice at the shift their sum matches best.

name: bridge-44100
about: At 44.1 kHz the search strides five frames, then tries each within a stride of the best.

name: bridge-48000
about: At 48 kHz the stride is six frames.

name: speed-up-16000
about: Speeding up strides the search too, nearest the playhead first: two frames at 16 kHz.
